[Verse 1]
[Bm]It's strange the way that past seems
[C#m]always fine While the
[Amaj7]present wears me down and
[F#m]time and time And time lies
[Bm]heavy over me as it
[C#m]does over you And the
[Amaj7]distance and what you said I
[F#m]know it wasn't true
[Bm]Every hour, every minute is
[C#m]like a hundred years And the
[Amaj7]pain I feel is measured not in
[F#m]inches but in tears So
[Bm]close, so woman, friend or foe
[C#m]Just
[Amaj7]hold me close and
[F#m]please don't let me go

[Bridge]
[Bm]
[C#m]
[Amaj7]
[F#m]Well, my

[C#m]morning in the day But the
[Amaj7]night is long the night is sad
[F#m]And
[Bm]that’s when I have the
[C#m]dreams I know you never had I
[Amaj7]know that I was wrong, I
[F#m]know that I was bad So
[Bm]baby, baby, baby, baby, ba-
[C#m]by, baby, baby
[Amaj7]Won't you

[Bm]walking down the street
[C#m]I see the people that
[Amaj7]meet each other They kiss and talk and talk
[F#m]and kiss and talk But I
[Bm]feel so alone
[C#m]And the
[Amaj7]world is made of stone And
[F#m]everybody’s freezing
[Bm]to the bones
[C#m]Even known
[Amaj7]it might be warm Even known

[C#m]always fine While the
[Amaj7]present wears me down and
[F#m]time and time And time lies
[Bm]heavy over me as it
[C#m]does over you And the
